preconditions.expression: G > 2 and N >= G - 2 and M >= 0
preconditions.description: G is the number of genes (G > 2), N is the number of mutation table rows (N ≥ G - 2), and M is the number of antibodies (M ≥ 0).

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= a < G and k >= 1 for a, k, *rest in mutation_table)
preconditions.description: Each mutation table row starts with a gene a (2 ≤ a < G) and a positive integer k (k ≥ 1), followed by k genes (0 ≤ b_i < G).

preconditions.expression: sum(k for a, k, *rest in mutation_table) <= 100
preconditions.description: The sum of all k values in the mutation table does not exceed 100.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= a < G for a, *rest in mutation_table) and len(set(a for a, *rest in mutation_table)) == G - 2
preconditions.description: Every integer from 2 to G - 1 appears exactly once as a gene a in the mutation table.

preconditions.expression: all(l >= 1 and all(0 <= c_i <= 1 for c_i in antibody) for l, *antibody in antibodies)
preconditions.description: Each antibody starts with a positive integer ℓ (ℓ ≥ 1), followed by ℓ genes (0 ≤ c_i ≤ 1).
The sum of all ℓ values in the antibodies does not exceed 50.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly G - 2 lines, one for each gene from 2 to G - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line in ['YES', 'NO ' + str(length)] for output_line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is either 'YES' (all viruses detectable) or 'NO ' followed by an integer length (shortest undetectable virus length).

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i] == 'YES') == (all_viruses_detectable_for_gene(i + 2, mutation_table, antibodies))) for i in range(G - 2))
postconditions.description: For each gene g (2 ≤ g < G), if all possible viruses derived from g are detectable by the antibodies, output 'YES'; otherwise, output 'NO ' followed by the minimal length of an undetectable virus.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i].startswith('NO')) == (not all_viruses_detectable_for_gene(i + 2, mutation_table, antibodies))) for i in range(G - 2))
postconditions.description: If no viruses can be derived from gene g (2 ≤ g < G), output 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i].split()[1] if output_lines[i].startswith('NO') else None) == min_undetectable_length_for_gene(i + 2, mutation_table, antibodies) if not all_viruses_detectable_for_gene(i + 2, mutation_table, antibodies) else None for i in range(G - 2))
postconditions.description: If viruses exist but are not all detectable, the length after 'NO ' is the minimal length of an undetectable virus derived from gene g (2 ≤ g < G).
